characters.description: Haven's leader and an accomplished hunter and alchemist with a close connection to Villy.
characters.name: Jake Thayne

characters.description: Jake's separate simulation-derived self within his soul space. With his temporary vessel failing and their training at its limit, he prepares to merge with Eternal Hunger.
characters.name: Sim Jake

characters.description: The primordial patron who leads the Malefic Order and supports Jake's path.
characters.name: Villy

characters.description: Villy's disciple and a Grand Elder of the Malefic Order. While observing Jake in the time chamber, he recognizes the exceptional concentration required to sustain Jake's long experiment.
characters.name: Duskleaf

characters.description: A powerful C-grade snake connected to Jake's circle.
characters.name: Scarlet

characters.description: Jake's chief administrator and a leader of Haven. She handles the settlement's practical and political affairs, coordinating responses to threats while Jake focuses on combat, advancement, and alchemy.
characters.name: Miranda

characters.description: Haven's inventor and a specialist in advanced machinery and void-related technology.
characters.name: Arnold

characters.description: A C-grade unique lifeform and combatant allied with Jake.
characters.name: Fallen King

characters.description: The Sword Saint, a transcendent swordsman and one of Earth's foremost combatants. He follows a highly disciplined path centered on sword technique.
characters.name: Miyamoto

characters.description: Jake's hawk companion and a gifted wielder of wind magic.
characters.name: Sylphie

characters.description: Jake's cosmic-worm ally. Although Jake influenced an earlier transformation, Sandy retains an independent path and remains an unusual, powerful member of Earth's allied circle.
characters.name: Sandy

characters.description: The leader of an ocean-based faction that seeks admission to Haven's protected region. It becomes the settlement council's final minister and explains that its unique origin limits its faction's role in the coming Prima Guardian conflict.
characters.name: Sky Whale

characters.description: A newly hatched C-grade humanoid bee queen created by Jake's completed ritual. She has four wings and antennae and addresses Jake as her honored sire, while her identity, abilities, and allegiance remain unknown.
characters.name: newly hatched bee queen

characters.description: A Vespernat Hive Queen and true royal born from Jake's completed ritual. She calls Jake her sire, possesses extensive inherited lineage knowledge, and regards her new life as a debt even after Jake states that she owes him no service.
characters.name: Vesperia

characters.description: An Order liaison and Humanoid Resources worker who understands its internal customs and politics. She assists Jake and his associates with enrollment, preparation, coordination, and access to the Order's services.
characters.name: Irin

characters.description: An elderly elven specialist in magical barriers. He studies Jake's stable arcane constructs, confirms that they have physical substance while remaining magical, and retains a record of the demonstration for further analysis.
characters.name: elderly barrier researcher

characters.description: Jake's contract-bound household attendant, an alchemist studying under Duskleaf. As she approaches C-grade, Jake insists that she choose a free future, leaving her to consider Order membership and what role she wants afterward.
characters.name: elven household worker

characters.description: A dragonkin representative who cultivates a friendship with Jake's elven attendant while seeking information about Jake and his presumed backer.
characters.name: Emberflight representative

characters.description: An A-grade true dragon of the Amber Flight who serves as the senior Emberflight participant in a meeting about Jake's bloodline. Her presence and authority signal that the flight considers the matter important.
characters.name: Alba Ramaz

characters.description: A C-grade member of the Malefic Order who agrees to help Jake discourage the Emberflight's investigation. He and Jake plan to appear as equal friends at a meeting with the dragonkin flight.
characters.name: malefic dragonkin

characters.description: A level-239 Isoptera Hive Queen blessed by the Fourth Desert Queen. She leads a local hive force and supports her guards with earth magic and healing.
characters.name: local Isoptera Hive Queen

characters.description: A level-239 defensive Isoptera variant assigned to protect the local Hive Queen among her cavern defenders.
characters.name: Isoptera Queen's Protector

characters.description: The divine patron associated with the Isoptera queens. After Jake kills one of her queens, she unsuccessfully attempts to place a divine brand and tracking mark on him.
characters.name: Fourth Desert Queen

characters.description: A level-272 Isoptera queen carrying the Fourth Desert Queen's greater blessing. She identifies herself as the hive's true queen, claims Earth for the Endless Empire, and seals the cavern when Jake rejects her terms.
characters.name: deeper Isoptera Hive Queen

characters.description: A level-272 Isoptera combatant encountered beside the deeper Hive Queen in a cavern far below the surface. It is substantially stronger than when Jake encountered it earlier.
characters.name: Isoptera Hive King

characters.description: A member of the Azure flight with the Venerated Azure Dragon's blessing. Hostile toward Jake's group, he falsely claims friendship with Villy's Chosen.
characters.name: Azure Dragonkin

characters.description: An associate of Scarlet who accompanies the Azure Dragonkin at dinner and appears subordinate to and afraid of him.
characters.name: Thunder Venom Adder

characters.description: The C-grade Chosen of the god challenging Villy. His patron presents him as Jake's coming opponent in Nevermore, shifting the divine conflict toward a public competition between their respective champions.
characters.name: rival Chosen

characters.description: An uninvited god who interrupts the Malefic Order's public ceremony and confronts Villy with an aura of equal force. His arrival turns the celebration of Villy's return into a direct divine challenge.
characters.name: rival god

characters.description: A primordial associated with karma whose aura halts the confrontation between Villy and the rival god. In private, he supports the rival god's effort to turn Jake against Villy and wants Villy killed.
characters.name: primordial of karma

characters.description: An eldritch entity who intercepts the travelers during inter-universal transit and gives Jake the bound Vision of Oris.
characters.name: void god

characters.description: An ancient life-aligned god, Villy's former father-in-law, and the patriarch of a nature-communion bloodline. He brings his sheltered dryad granddaughter to be considered for Jake's final Nevermore party position.
characters.name: nature attendant

characters.description: A young dryad and highly trained druid-healer who has lived a sheltered life under her grandfather's protection. Selected as Jake's fifth Nevermore member, she specializes entirely in nature magic and brings a guardian with her.
characters.name: Dina

characters.description: A soul tree supported by two Ethgleam Elderbark Treants, encountered in Haven's forest during a standoff with a group of C-grade fire bears.
characters.name: Ethgleam Mother Tree

characters.description: A member of Jake's Earth delegation whose prior exposure to Jake's bloodline helps him withstand divine presence.
characters.name: Caleb

characters.description: The mortal Hallmaster of the Malefic Order and a late S-grade disciple of the Verdant Witches. She helps prepare the public ceremony for Jake and Vesperia.
characters.name: Viridia

characters.description: A devoted Primordial Church sculptor who presents his life's work as a ceremonial gift honoring Jake and Villy.
characters.name: Felix

characters.description: A sheltered young dryad and highly trained druid brought by her grandfather for consideration as the fifth member of Jake's Nevermore party.
characters.name: dryad candidate
